text:
tom: quick poll for the commute crew  what's one album or single that always wakes you up on a crappy morning? need something 30-60 mins to feel human.

lina: In Rainbows  Radiohead. always lifts me. :coffee:

ben: guilty-pleasure nomination: Britney Spears - Oops!...I Did It Again. full sing-along, zero shame. :microphone:

aria: M83 - Midnight City for immediate cinematic energy. also: shoutout to Little Dragon for chill+pep.

tom: love it. poll: reply with "album" or "single" so I can shape a playlist

ben: single

lina: album

codebot: POLL UPDATE: album 1, single 1

aria: single (adding my vote)

codebot: POLL UPDATE: album 1, single 2

tom: tie broken? fine. also throwing in a movie rec for morning vibes: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty (2013)  very sunrise-roadtrip energy.

lina: TV ep rec for 20 min calm: Chef's Table S1E1  slow, beautiful, good coffee visuals.

aria: book rec for short commutes: The Art of Noticing by Rob Walker  tiny prompts you can do between stops.

ben: dropping playlist link (placeholder): https://tiny.redwood/commute-shuffle. added Britney + M83 + Radiohead.

giphy-bot: [GIF: tiny car driving into sunrise  reaction GIF]

tom: ok last call before I lock it: any morning-friendly guilty songs?

lina: add: Electric Feel  MGMT

aria: add: Holocene  Bon Iver

ben: added both. locking playlist now :lock:

tom: perfect. thanks team  will report back if this playlist saves my life tomorrow morning. :headphones:
